text:
I'm sorry about the frustration. Unfortunately, I can't refund this charge. Plant Club boxes are billed on the 25th of the previous month, so your $49 was already billed before you cancelled on the 26th. Cancelling on or after the 25th applies to the following month's box, and an already-billed box isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent.

Your cancellation should stop any charges after this box, and the plant it ships in the first full week of the month comes with the normal plant guarantee. If you'd like someone to review your situation, I can escalate it to a Support Lead, though I can't promise a different outcome.
